users.","kind":"broad-generalization","verification_question":"What evidence shows that repairs delivered through these remote channels provide user benefits?"}]},{"id":"p2s4","status":"keep","reason":"This is an argumentative conclusion about the ownership significance of the dual-use arrangement posited in the preceding power.","claims":[]},{"id":"p2s6","status":"keep","reason":"This is a metaphorical decision rule equating effective ownership with final control, adding no external premise.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s1","status":"keep","reason":"The sentence clearly introduces an imagined workshop analogy rather than reporting a real actor or events.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s3","status":"keep","reason":"This is a classificatory judgment about the imagined arrangement.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s4","status":"keep","reason":"The landlord, deed, receipt, and master-key language is a coherent metaphor for nominal possession coupled with retained seller control.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s5","status":"keep","reason":"This is a rhetorical conclusion that terminology does not eliminate the posited division of control.","claims":[]},{"id":"p4s1","status":"keep","reason":"The manufacturer and its possible answers are expressly cases?"}]},{"id":"p4s3","status":"keep","reason":"This is a conceptual conclusion that revocability is inconsistent with the essay’s stated definition of property-like
